_comment: The eidolon gantry's winch (EidolonGantry/README.md, 'The build'): its nine stages after the frame and their materials, as its rig's parts draw them; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema) and kept by the shared machine base (docs/modeling/machine-base.md). Each stage takes its whole count from the stack held in one click; the iron parts are iron, meteoric iron or steel. {wood} is the gantry's own wood (EidolonGantry/Core/GantryBuild.cs fills it in): the drum's planks and the spine's beams. The eidolon's body follows on the spine by rules of its own (EidolonGantry/Core/BodyParts.cs), not this file's. Nothing wears. No block: the gantry's construction record is its own in the recipe export (EidolonExport.cs reads this file), not the ore machines' generic one.
